## Introduction

This vignette demonstrates how to use the WNNForecast package
to perform time series forecasting.

```{r}
library(WNNForecast)

set.seed(123)
series <- rnorm(200)

forecast <- wnn_forecast(series, k = 5, h = 10, l = 5)

forecast
